hypothesis: ETF relative momentum adds net value to a strategic stock-bond-gold core only when leaders beat an investable defensive hurdle and cross-sectional trend dispersion is sufficiently wide.

frozen_candidate.signal_time: last close of previous trading week
frozen_candidate.defensive_hurdle: per horizon max(0, SH511010 return, SH511880 return)
frozen_candidate.dispersion_measure: cross-sectional IQR of 126-session returns after lifecycle, history, deduplication and liquidity filters
frozen_candidate.unused_active_budget: returned pro rata to the 40/40/20 strategic core

out_of_sample.method: expanding-window annual selection by in-sample Sharpe

success_criteria.cost_adjusted_increment: At 20bp single-side all-in cost, frozen v2 annualized return exceeds the identically costed static core.
success_criteria.rolling_three_year: At least 60% of month-end rolling three-year windows beat the static core and the worst three-year active excess is greater than -10%.
success_criteria.risk_improvement: At least two of: Sharpe exceeds core by 0.05, maximum drawdown is no worse than core, worst rolling three-year return is no worse than core.
success_criteria.standalone_satellite: Standalone conditional satellite has positive Sharpe at baseline and 20bp costs.
success_criteria.multiple_testing: Approximate PBO is at most 40% and frozen-candidate DSR probability is at least 80%.
success_criteria.concentration: Top positive-contribution ETF share is at most 25% and excluding the top contributor preserves positive annualized excess over core.
success_criteria.capacity: At RMB 10 million under strict 0.5% ADV trade participation, average active exposure remains at least 20% and annualized excess over core is positive.
success_criteria.platform: JoinQuant PIT Research replay and official scheduling do not reverse the sign of the frozen candidate's excess over its strategic core.

decision_rule: No parameter selected from full-sample results may replace the frozen candidate. A failed criterion is reported as failure rather than repaired by an exception rule.
